description: A steel box with a hinged lid and a handle worn smooth, packed the way people pack things they hope never to open: hose in three diameters, jubilee clips, a coil of brake line, spare emitter tape, two fuses that are the wrong rating and one that is not, and a tube of something that says it seals anything. It is heavy in the way that reassures you at the yard and annoys you every single mile after.
name: box of truck spares
